theorem: For every parameter in the revalidated family, h(t)>0 for 0<t<L. Half-period symmetry gives h(t)<0 for L<t<2L. The sole upward zero in [0,2L) is t=0, so the least positive period is exactly 2L.
limitations: Uses the same interval integrator as the cycle certificate
Does not prove a nonlinear bifurcation or a chaotic attractor
